estimand.primary_movement: mean exact full-vocabulary total variation TV(q_alpha,p_student); TV is used instead of KL for the retained-fraction claim because both TV and log-probability gain are first order locally
estimand.prompt_sensitivity: mean pairwise full-vocabulary TV across neutral/terse/verbose paths
estimand.task_signal: mean correct-answer log-probability gain in nats/token, first within query then equally over 72 queries and 3 wrappers

definition.deviation: mean KL(q_loop||p_student) over queries and wrappers
definition.wrapper_sensitivity: mean over queries of population variance across three wrappers in realized per-loop update KL

study_3_horizon.caveat: historical matched-horizon behavior, not a projection-only causal ablation; source protocols are documented in EXPERIMENTAL_SETTINGS.md
study_3_horizon.metric: strict Acc@1 on the frozen 143-question AMC23/AIME24/AIME25 set
